THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE ANOMALY APPEARED TO EMANATE FROM THE SITE OF THE THOMAS HEYWARD SHIPWRECK, A REPEAT LEAK SOURCE. IT EXTENDED 3.1 NMI SOUTHWESTWARD FROM THE SUSPECTED SOURCE AND WAS UP TO 0.1 NMI IN WIDTH. THE ANOMALY HAD A DISTINCT, DARK APPEARANCE AGAINST ITS BACKGROUND WITH SHARP EDGES. WINDS AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE FROM THE NE AT AROUND 5 KTS. UNCERTAINTIES: THERE WERE SEVERAL FALSE POSITIVES IN THE FORM OF VESSEL WAKES AND LIKELY NATURAL PHENOMENA OBSERVED THROUGHOUT OTHER PORTIONS OF THE IMAGE SWATH. HOWEVER, THIS ANOMALY HAD AN APPEARANCE VERY DISTINCT FROM THOSE FEATURES. THIS, COMBINED WITH THE REPEAT LEAK NATURE OF THE SUSPECTED SOURCE, ALLOWED FOR HIGH CONFIDENCE THAT THIS WAS OIL.

THE OIL WAS RELEASED FROM TWO 5-GALLON JUGS BY HANGING THEM ONE AT A TIME OVER THE SIDE ONE AT A TIME AND PUNCTURING THE CONTAINER. THE SECOND JUG WAS EMPTIED SLOWER THAN THE FIRST. EVENT OCCURRED WITHIN THE US EEZ.

Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTS TWO SEWAGE OVERFLOWS IN THE TOWN OF SAINT STEPHENS DUE TO HEAVY RAIN. BOTH OVERFLOWS ARE ONGOING AND THE SEWAGE IS RELEASED TO THE SAINT CROIX RIVER. THIS IS A COMBINED SEWER SYSTEM, THE PROPORTION OR RUNOFF WATER TO SEWAGE IS UNKNOWN AT THIS TIME AND NO REMEDIATION METHODS ARE IN PLACE. THE OVERFLOWS BEGAN AT 13H30. THE FIRST LIFT STATION OVERFLOW IS TAKING PLACE AT THE PARKING LOT NUMBER 4 ON MILLTOWN BOULEVARD (45.1921, -67.2814). THE FLOW RATE IS APPROXIMATELY 178 CUBIC METRES PER HOUR. THE SECOND LIFT STATION OVERFLOW IS TAKING PLACE AT LIFT STATION 1 ON 47 BUDD AVENUE (45.1920, -67.2716). THE FLOW RATE IS APPROXIMATELY 23.9 CUBIC METRES PER HOUR. UPDATE 1 CALLER REPORTS THAT, DUE TO THE RAIN, A THIRD STATION IS OVERFLOWING SINCE 14H30 (ONGOING). THE STATION IS LOCATED AT THE CIVIC CENTRE ON BUDD AVENUE (GEOLOCATION: 45.1929, -67.2740). THIS STATION ALSO OVERFLOWS INTO THE SAINT CROIX RIVER. THE ESTIMATED FLOW RATE IS 272 M3/H. UPDATE 2 CALLER IS REPORTING THAT TWO OUT OF THREE LIFT STATIONS HAVE STOPPED BYPASSING. PARKING LOT NUMBER 4 ON MILLTOWN BOULEVARD (45.1921, -67.2814) STOPPED AT 18H30 FOR A TOTAL DISCHARGE ESTIMATED AT 890M3. CIVIC CENTRE ON BUDD AVENUE (45.1929, -67.2740) STOPPED AT 16H30 FOR A TOTAL DISCHARGE ESTIMATED AT 544M3. UPDATE 3 CALLER REPORTS LIFT STATION 1 ON 47 BUDD AVENUE (45.1920, -67.2716) STOPPED OVERFLOWING AT 21H00 ON 2019/07/12. TOTAL DISCHARGE IS 658 CUBIC METERS.

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 30.26838, -91.321173 (Approximated from establishment)
Report DescriptionCRITICAL INCIDENT COMMUNICATIONS REPORT: BAYOU GROSSE TETE BRIDGE ALLISION / WATERWAY CLOSURE - THIS MORNING AT 1012Z (0512 LOCAL), THE TOWING VESSEL (T/V) JOSSET WITH A THREE-BARGE TOW ALLIDED WITH THE BAYOU GROSSE TETE SWING BRIDGE IN PLAQUEMINE, LA. - THE TOW WAS HEADED UPBOUND FROM MORGAN CITY IN THE MORGAN CITY - PORT ALLEN ALTERNATE ROUTE, PART OF THE INTRACOASTAL WATERWAY. - THE BARGES STRUCK THE BRIDGE WHEN IT WAS IN THE DOWN POSITION. - LOUISIANA STATE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION (LA DOT), SHERIFF’S DEPARTMENT, AND MSU BATON ROUGE ALL RESPONDED. - THERE IS NO DAMAGE TO THE BARGES OR T/V JOSSET. - THE BRIDGE IS SEVERELY DAMAGED AND IS STUCK IN THE CLOSED POSITION AND OUT OF ALIGNMENT. - THE ROADWAY ON THE BRIDGE, HIGHWAY 77, IS IMPASSABLE. - THE WATERWAY IS ALSO IMPASSABLE DUE TO THE BRIDGE BEING STUCK DOWN. - THERE ARE NO INJURIES OR POLLUTION ASSOCIATED WITH THIS INCIDENT. - THE LA DOT ESTIMATES THE DAMAGE TO BE IN THE MILLIONS OF DOLLARS, BUT CANNOT PROVIDE AN ACCURATE ESTIMATE AT THIS TIME. - LA DOT IS CURRENTLY WORKING ON REOPENING THE WATERWAY. - THE ROADWAY ACROSS THE BRIDGE MAY BE IMPASSABLE FOR AT LEAST A MONTH. - THERE IS LOCAL MEDIA INTEREST, BUT NO NATIONAL MEDIA INTEREST. - THERE IS NO VESSEL QUEUE AT THIS TIME, AND VEHICLE TRAFFIC FOR THE AREA IS BEING REROUTED ACROSS OTHER ICW BRIDGES.

Report DescriptionTHE CALLER STATED THAT WHILE A TRUCKING COMPANY WAS DELIVERING PRODUCT TO THE LOCATION PROVIDED, (2) 55-GALLON DRUMS WERE DROPPED OUTSIDE OF THE LOADING BAY DOORS. THE DRUMS RELEASED 900 POUNDS OF ZOLTEK-65L SIZING AND 90 POUNDS OF BUTOLXYETHANOL ONTO THE PAVEMENT AND SURROUNDING SOIL. THE CAUSE OF THE RELEASE IS UNKNOWN AND THE EXACT AMOUNT OF MATERIAL THAT RELEASED IS ALSO UNKNOWN AT THIS TIME. ACCORDING TO THE CALLER THEY DID NOT INITIALLY REPORT THIS INCIDENT BECAUSE THEY WERE UNDER THE IMPRESSION THAT A DIFFERENT MATERIAL WAS BEING DELIVERED.
